gpt6-ui: Phased availability versus October 8 plan; paid Sol versus Free/Go Luna; Chat only; short WIRED trial not an accuracy test
haiku55: Per million tokens; 100,000-token threshold; $0.10/$0.50 versus $0.50/$2.50; 90%/50% tiers; limited 1.25x tokenizer observation
windows-spark: October 16 laptop versus November desktop plans; 128GB; 1 petaFLOP at FP4 is a peak configuration figure; MXC original name; no blanket offline/no-upload claim
synthid: Supported watermarks; global English entry point; Apple remains planned; missing watermark proves neither human origin nor truth
teen-safety: Future College Planner; US grades 10–12 and four-year colleges; more than 4,000 prompts; targeted scenarios and model-change confound; no voice/group/image coverage; company response attributed
playground: US 18+; subscription tiers; Unity Spark closed beta remains planned
wikimedia-agents: October 5 background rediscovered October 7; unsuccessful Etherpad exploit; no compromise; sandbox edits; May outage association not causation
discourse-roost: October 7 publication versus unknown UN-week recording date; publisher lightly edited AI-assisted transcript, paraphrases only; editorial linkage not guest response
discourse-painter: METR original expansion; September 30 written testimony, not oral Q&A; recommendations not adopted rules; predates October 5 investigation
veriharness: October 1 v1 versus October 5 HF discovery; five benchmarks, two models, ten fixed candidates; 6.2/6.4 score points rather than percent; no reproduction
open-d1: 3B text/image versus experimental 600M text+image or audio; incomplete multimodal evaluation; LFM Open License v1.0 commercial revenue restriction; open weights
